subject: Aging brains draft blood-borne immune reinforcements: the blood-brain barrier is not a wall
script: From Agewell Brief: Aging brains draft blood-borne immune reinforcements: the blood-brain barrier is not a wall. New findings suggest that the brain's immune isolation is not absolute—aging may open a regulated door for peripheral immune cells to enter and reshape neuroinflammation. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
